title: RIP, vector database
summary: A Hacker News discussion (352 points, 100 comments) around a turbopuffer blog post titled 'RIP, vector database,' which argues that dedicated vector databases may be losing relevance as general-purpose databases and search engines absorb vector search capabilities. Commenters debate tradeoffs around performance, cost, and whether specialized vector stores still have a place in modern RAG and AI application stacks.
